Which statement best compares the standard deviations of the numbers of glue sticks brought in by each student for these two classes?\x3C/p>",rationale:"\x3Cp style=\"text-align: left;\">Choice B is correct. Standard deviation is a measure of the spread of a data set from its mean. The dot plot for class A and the dot plot for class B have the same shape. Thus, the frequency distributions for both class A and class B are the same. Since both class A and class B have the same frequency distribution of glue sticks brought in by each student, it follows that both class A and class B have the same spread of the number of glue sticks brought in by each student from their respective means.
